title: Censoring for the Potts model
statement: Consider the $q$-state Potts model (say with $q=3$ for concreteness) and start from all green. Is it the case that deterministically censoring a sequence of spin flips can only increase the total variation distance to stationarity?
status: This is known for monotone chains by [Peres, Winkler].
model_definition: P(sigma) proportional to exp(beta sum over (i,j) in E of 1{sigma_i=sigma_j})
